# Sample Transport Protocol

This document defines a compact test protocol.

## 1. Negotiation

When the offered version is unsupported, the server MUST reject the
offer and return a version error unless fallback mode is enabled.

The client SHOULD NOT send a second offer on the same connection.

## 2. Tokens

The client MUST generate a fresh token and MUST NOT reuse that token.

A token MAY be omitted when anonymous mode is negotiated.
